notes:
**CHR-1257 phase 2b, Stitch chrome (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** Redesigned as the equivalent: the New project dialog opened inside a project (project menu, New project…) over `app-shell`, with the name field focused. Same folder picker as `init-project-dialog` (which is the no-project case).

- Native `<dialog>` in the `float-dialog` shell, 560px, top 96px; h1 "New project", sub "Choose where the new project folder is created.", close.
- Places: three `quick-chip`s (`aria-pressed`, Workspace current). Path: `nav` "Folder path" with an `ol` of crumbs (decorative chevrons `aria-hidden`, current folder `aria-current`), `new-folder-btn` at the right.
- Folders: `chrome-field` tray, `role=listbox`, `chrome-list-row` options (portfolio `selected`, notes-app badged Project).
- `text-field` `focus` "Project name" = my-new-project, hint "Will create: ~/Workspace/portfolio/my-new-project" (`aria-describedby`).
- Footer: `btn` Cancel, `btn` `confirm` "Create & open". Close, Cancel, scrim and confirm flow back to `app-shell`.
